blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Authorities on Wednesday called for the extension of the buffer zone where tobacco products are prohibited from being sold and displayed, urging to widen the separation distance to 500 meters from 100 meters. Dominic Maddumba, who heads the Department of Health’s (DOH) health promotion bureau, asked lawmakers to expand smoke-free zones, raising the proposal during a congressional hearing where the House Health Committee subsequently passed an anti-smoking bill. “Let’s expand the 100 meters to 500 meters, if possible,” he said in Filipino.
